PAINTING & BODYWORK · Body Repair

Scratch Repair in Riyadh

Scratch repair for luxury car paint in Riyadh — from clearcoat marks polished out to deep scratches refinished properly, assessed honestly from photos first.

  1. Home
  2. Painting & Bodywork
  3. Scratch Repair

The right scratch repair depends entirely on how deep the scratch goes. Marks confined to the clearcoat can often be machine-polished away completely; scratches through the color coat need localized refinishing; anything reaching metal or plastic must be sealed and refinished properly before corrosion or spread sets in. The fingernail test is a rough guide — a photo assessment is better, and QSC will tell you honestly when a scratch needs polishing rather than paint, because the cheaper correct repair is still the correct repair.

Scratch repair rewards accurate triage more than any other paint service. The depth ladder — clearcoat, color, primer, substrate — maps directly to both method and cost, and the difference between its rungs can be a factor of ten in price. A workshop that polishes what needed paint wastes your money once; one that paints what needed polishing wastes it every time. QSC's assessment, usually possible from good photographs, places the scratch on that ladder before any commitment, and the recommendation names the rung and the reasoning.

Riyadh's light is merciless to mediocre scratch work: desert sun at low angles reveals halos around polished spots, sanding marks under fresh clear, and blend edges that cooler, cloudier climates would hide. The finishing standard here has to be set against that light. It also argues for timeliness on deep scratches — anything through to primer or metal oxidizes and spreads under paint far faster in this heat, converting a small refinish into a larger one within months.

When to book this service

  • Light swirls and marks visible in sunlight
  • A distinct scratch from a key, branch, or brush with an object
  • A scuff from a parking barrier, kerb or another bumper
  • Deep scratches showing primer or bare material

How QSC handles it

Depth assessment: clearcoat, color coat, primer or substrate

Machine polishing and finish correction where the clearcoat allows

Localized refinishing with color matching where the scratch goes deeper

Verification that the repaired area blends with the surrounding finish

  • Accurate depth triage from photos — before any commitment
  • Polish when polishing is the answer; paint only when it is not
  • Finishing judged against Riyadh's revealing desert light
  • Deep scratches prioritized before heat-driven corrosion grows the job

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can polishing remove my scratch completely?

Only if the scratch is confined to the clearcoat. Polishing removes a little clearcoat to level the surface — done right, on the right scratch, the mark is gone for good. Deeper scratches need refinishing, and pretending otherwise just wastes a polish.

Are scratch-repair pens worth trying first?

They can mask small chips at a distance, but they do not repair anything, and layered DIY attempts can make professional refinishing harder. For a car you care about, have the depth assessed first.

Someone scratched my car in a parking lot. What should I photograph?

The whole panel from a step back, the scratch straight-on, and a close angle shot in daylight. That is enough for an initial assessment by WhatsApp.

The dealer quoted a full panel for one scratch — is that ever right?

Sometimes, honestly, yes: certain colors and scratch positions cannot be blended invisibly within a partial area, and a full panel is the only clean result. But it is the exception, not the default. Send us the photos — if a localized repair will genuinely disappear, that is what we will recommend.
